lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with a spatial distribution that widens as it progresses toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, particularly visible in the mid-flank region where blobs are centered within the vertical band boundaries.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges exhibit a high-contrast gradient, running parallel across the dorsal-lateral surface from the gill arches toward the posterior flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct indentation is observed on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
